page.size: 4:3 (10 x 7.5 in) in five of six decks (2019-Jan 2025); 16:9 widescreen (13.33 x 7.5 in) in Utz (May 2026)
page.aspect_ratio: 1.333 (Aircastle c-5, Liberty, Aspen, Whole Earth; Aircastle c-2 images 1.385, treated as 4:3), 1.778 (Utz 2026)
page.margins_note: New template (2024-25): ~0.3in side margins; content runs nearly edge-to-edge; Aspen titles sit ~1.1in from the top with large empty band above (title baseline ~11% down), Liberty titles ~0.6in from top under the red draft legend. Footer band ~0.5in: source/notes at left from ~0.3in, logo + vertical bar + page number at bottom right. Old template (2019/2023): title starts at very top (~0.1in), thin grey rule under title at ~6-7% down, footnotes bottom-left above a page number at the far bottom-left. Utz 16:9: ~0.3in side margins, title ~0.9in from top under the boxed draft legend; logo | page number bottom-right as in other new-template decks.

tables.borders_and_rules: minimal verticals; header underlines in blue per column group; thick navy horizontal rules framing summary 'Implied Share Price' strips; dotted rules for spanning headers; banded grey rows (#D2DADD/#F2F2F2) Legacy (Aircastle c-2): thin grey horizontal rules between row groups, cyan rule closing the table, no verticals. Utz tracker: dotted grey row separators, thin vertical column rules.

Legacy: bold blue/navy headers; spanning headers ('Price / Pre-Tax Income') centred over year sub-columns; cyan bold section labels ('Considered But Excluded:').

disagreements_between_decks: Template by era: legacy (Aircastle c-2 and c-5 2019, Whole Earth Oct 2023) = Arial, navy #002D72 titles over a grey rule, cyan #00BDF2 accents, page number bottom-left. New (Liberty Dec 2024, Aspen Jan 2025, Utz May 2026) = Citi brand sans, bright blue #255BE2 titles with no rule, logo | page number bottom-right.
Page shape: all 4:3 except Utz 2026 at 16:9; the newest deck has moved to widescreen.

Football field (one per template): legacy uses navy core bars, grey reference bars, cents labels, two magenta dashed offer-range lines and assumptions written inside the plot; new uses uniform blue bars, grey label boxes for reference rows, whole-dollar labels, one green dashed consideration line, a separate assumptions column and an implied-multiples panel.

Draft legends vary: Liberty has a red italic 'Preliminary | Confidential – Draft...' line on every page; Utz a red dashed box 'Preliminary Draft | Subject to Review and Revision by Citi's Fairness Opinion Committee'; Aspen has none; Whole Earth only a red 'ILLUSTRATIVE DRAFT' on the cover; Aircastle c-2 uses page-level 'For Illustrative Purposes and Reference Only' tags instead.
Covers differ even within the new template: Liberty blue-wave hero image; Aspen thin rounded blue frame; Utz dotted-wave graphic on white.
Aspen's title block sits lower with more top whitespace and a larger title size than Liberty or Utz.
Logo on content pages: present bottom-right in Aircastle, Liberty, Aspen, Utz; absent in Whole Earth.
Subject highlighting: legacy uses pale cyan rows and yellow output cells; new uses pale blue rows inside red dashed boxes and red dashed ellipses.
confidence_notes: Six Citi decks. Analysis conventions now rest on two decks, one per template: Aspen 2025 (new) and Aircastle (c)(2) 2019 (legacy), each with a football field, a DCF/DDM with sensitivity grids and comps tables. Precedent-transactions table style still rests on Aspen alone (Aircastle has premiums paid, not precedent multiples). Utz 2026 confirms the new template's furniture and introduces 16:9 but has no valuation pages. Aircastle (c)(5) and Whole Earth are limited (process update; buy-side LBO). Liberty is NAV-driven. Aircastle (c)(2) images are low resolution (780x563), so its small-text colors are approximate. Hex codes measured on solid fills; the face name for the new template remains the least certain item.

dcf.examples: Aspen 'Illustrative Discounted Cash Flow Analysis – Alpha Mgmt. LRP' (new); Aircastle c-2 'Discounted Dividends Analysis' (legacy, a DDM because the target is a lessor)
dcf.layout: New: full-width blue section bar 'Unlevered Free Cash Flow Profile' over the projection table (years as columns, separate 'Terminal Year' column), then 'Illustrative Sensitivity Analysis' bar over three side-by-side 3x3 grids (equity value per share, implied terminal multiple, TV as % of EV) and a tornado-style sensitivity of value per share. Legacy: left column with 'Assumptions' bullets and 'Sensitivity Analysis' grids (3x3, discount rate x terminal multiple and x target leverage), right column with the projection table.
dcf.sensitivity_grids: Column variable in a header band ('Illustrative Discount Rate' cyan in legacy; 'Perpetuity Growth Rate' blue underline in new); row variable label rotated vertically at left in legacy, plain left column in new; first row carries $ and the rest bare; base case at centre.
dcf.line_items: metric rows bold blue (new) / bold black (legacy) with italic '% Growth', '% Margin' rows beneath; deductions labelled '(–) SBC', '(+) Interest Income'.
